title: I made a pixel-art roguelike solo from Argentina, and it's finally out on Steam and Google Play (free demo on Steam)
author: Open_Newspaper9641
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm Rafa, a solo indie dev from Argentina, and I'm really happy to share that \*\*Gloamfall\*\* is finally out on Steam (Early Access) and on Google Play.



It's a dark-fantasy pixel-art roguelike with twin-stick combat and action-RPG loot:



\- 7 acts, 14 biomes and 15 three-phase bosses

\- 6 heroes and 70 weapons, plus armor you forge that carries over between runs

\- Play solo, in local co-op with two controllers, or online with a friend

\- Full controller support



I put everything I had into this game, and I honestly think you won't regret picking it up. If you'd rather try it first, there's a \*\*free demo on Steam\*\* with the first two acts. On Android the download is free too: you play the first two acts and unlock the rest with a single purchase.



Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371080/Gloamfall/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371080/Gloamfall/)

Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gloamfallstudio.gloamfall](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gloamfallstudio.gloamfall)

Trailer: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOiR0kvyHHQ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOiR0kvyHHQ)



Any feedback is super welcome. Thanks for reading!
